theme.archetype: Archetype 7 (Electric & Neon) combined with Archetype 5 (Luxury) - Tactical Cyber-Minimalism
theme.description: Deep dark theme with neon accent (electric blue / violet), Apple-esque / Linear-style, sleek, premium, motivating, disciplined vibe. Obsidian blacks, sharp 1px electric blue/cyan borders, glowing active states. No broad gradients.

heading.usage: Hero numbers, main countdown, large headers

mono.usage: Data labels, stats, code-like elements, overlines

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-bold font-['Unbounded']
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-semibold font-['Unbounded']

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Control Room Mode (Bento Grid) with Asymmetry
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8. Use ample padding in empty areas.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-xl for inner elements, rounded-full for pills/buttons

centerpiece_3d.instructions: Place a rotating low-poly geometric flame or trophy. Use <Environment preset='city'> or dark studio lighting. Bind the rotation/scale or emissive intensity to the 'streak' value. Add orbital rings using <Torus> geometry around the exam countdown text.
centerpiece_3d.placement: col-span-full md:col-span-8 lg:col-span-6 row-span-2 min-h-[300px] md:min-h-[400px] relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-[#0A0A0B] border border-white/5

cards.style: Flat 0A0A0B background with 1px border-white/5. On hover, use framer-motion to create a magnetic border-glow effect or 'Tracing Beam' (Aceternity style) using an animated radial gradient.

habits_list.style: Vertical list, rounded-xl items with hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors p-3.
habits_list.checkbox: Custom animated checkbox using Framer Motion. On check -> pop scale (scale: 1.2 then 1) + trigger confetti burst (using canvas-confetti). Accent color #00F0FF.

heatmap.style: GitHub-style grid but neon themed. Empty: bg-white/5, Low: bg-[#00F0FF]/20, Med: bg-[#00F0FF]/50, High: bg-[#00F0FF]. Include hover tooltips for each square showing date and completed count.

percentage_ring.style: SVG based circular progress indicator. Track: stroke-white/10, Progress: stroke-[#00F0FF] with drop-shadow glow. Add a central large text percentage using Unbounded font.

buttons.primary: bg-transparent border border-[#00F0FF] text-[#00F0FF] hover:bg-[#00F0FF] hover:text-black transition-all duration-300 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.2)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(0,240,255,0.6)] px-6 py-3 rounded-full font-['Manrope'] font-semibold

animations.entrance: Staggered fade-in and slide-up (y: 20 -> 0) for bento grid cards. Use framer-motion variants on a container with staggerChildren: 0.1.
animations.hover: Magnetic hover effect on cards, subtle scale-up on buttons (scale: 1.02).
animations.microinteractions: Checkbox confetti, streak counter ticking up on mount, countdown rings orbiting in 3D.

login_background.description: Abstract textured dark geometric background, use with a heavy black gradient overlay (bg-black/80) so text is readable.

user_avatar.description: Premium professional user portrait for dashboard header.

icons.installation_instructions: yarn add react-icons @phosphor-icons/react canvas-confetti @react-three/fiber @react-three/drei three framer-motion clsx tailwind-merge

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: `yarn add @react-three/fiber @react-three/drei three framer-motion canvas-confetti react-icons @phosphor-icons/react`
Implement Google Auth mock using localStorage. Show the login page first with the provided abstract background.
Use 'Unbounded' font for numbers/headings, 'Manrope' for body, and 'JetBrains Mono' for labels. Add Google Fonts import to index.html or global css.

Create the 3D Centerpiece in a distinct React component using React Three Fiber. Add a subtle ambient light, a point light (electric blue), and a low-poly rotating mesh (e.g., Icosahedron or Cone for a flame/trophy) that reacts to the streak count.
For the daily habits, implement a localized confetti effect. When a user clicks a checkbox, trigger a burst of cyan/violet particles using canvas-confetti or Framer Motion.
Ensure the layout is highly responsive. On mobile, stack everything cleanly. On desktop, maintain the 'Command Center' bento box look using the defined columns.
Apply `data-testid` to all interactive and key data elements (e.g., `data-testid='login-button'`, `data-testid='habit-checkbox-1'`).
Remember the 'Linear-style' aesthetic: dark backgrounds, subtle 1px borders, high-contrast text, glowing primary accents. AVOID flat white backgrounds or generic purple gradients.
